entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,601 K, because gSP-Phot fits an extinction A_G = 1.40 mag toward this star (Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), ag_gspphot), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; GSP-Phot measured its temperature, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffdfc0. entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,601 K and log g 1.76 (u1 0.737, u2 0.067): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
